d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi men ek aisa anokha ghora pahuncha hai, jiski nasl se lekar khanpan tak charcha ho rahi hai. sindhi nasl ke is ghore ko kaju-pista khilaya jata hai aur iski kaee khasiyten ise baki ghoron se alag banati hain. aakhir is ghore ki kimat, raphtar aur shahi andaj ke pichhe kya hai khas? dekhie yah khas riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
